findings.title: Anchor comparison counts to native and decoded evidence
findings.description: validate_comparison checks count consistency internally, but candidate_reports does not check native_count against the corresponding observed native output length or candidate_count against pytorch_onnx_decoded.onnx_count/reference_count. An internally consistent mutation of native_count and unmatched_native is accepted and can change selection microF1 despite unchanged raw native evidence.
findings.reproduction: Copy one completed development candidate scope; increment policy.geometry.groups.objects.native_count and unmatched_native by1; invoke candidate_reports on the ignored copy with native-development-1.json. It is accepted.
findings.expected: Reject mismatched native_count for geometry and scores, and anchor ONNX candidate_count to decoded onnx_count, Torch-native candidate_count to decoded reference_count. Same ONNX proposal count should hold across geometry/full-score requests.
findings.actual: Mutation accepted. All currently inspected actual records independently satisfy the proposed anchors; this finding is missing enforcement, not observed data corruption.
